schemas.name: common
schemas.purpose: Reusable exact identities, typed endpoints, statuses and diagnostics.

schemas.name: baseline-snapshot
schemas.purpose: Exact source snapshot with explicit source/effective-state overlay; no claim of perpetual freshness.

schemas.name: relation-kind
schemas.purpose: Normalized declaration retaining ordered pairs, original qualifier schema and forbidden justifications.

schemas.name: registry-snapshot
schemas.purpose: A finite registry declaration import; counts and hash bindings are recomputed by the consumer.

schemas.name: semantic-profile
schemas.purpose: Explicit candidate semantic input profile with reviewed meaning required before semantic readiness.

schemas.name: relation-assertion
schemas.purpose: Identified relation assertion. Dynamic qualifier validity is checked against the selected kind declaration.

schemas.name: graph
schemas.purpose: Finite identified graph. Identity uniqueness and endpoint referential integrity are contract obligations.

schemas.name: normalization-report
schemas.purpose: Field-preservation projection, exact dependencies and remaining parser trust boundary.

schemas.name: reference-assessment
schemas.purpose: Resolution assessment does not upgrade an arbitrary qualifier string into authenticated authority.

schemas.name: coverage-ledger
schemas.purpose: Keep declaration import, structural checks, defined semantics, proofs and unsupported obligations distinct.

schemas.name: change-proposal
schemas.purpose: Exact baseline and proposed graph/registry/rules identities; author labels are checked against an independent diff.

schemas.name: semantic-diff
schemas.purpose: Normalized exact changes computed by the consumer, not accepted from author labels.

schemas.name: obligation
schemas.purpose: An independently required statement with exact premises, scope and permitted evidence methods.

schemas.name: obligation-set
schemas.purpose: Complete required set generated from actual diff and selected policy; client-submitted subsets are not authoritative.

schemas.name: rule-profile
schemas.purpose: Finite positive function-free range-restricted profile with explicitly defined protected roots.

schemas.name: rule-set
schemas.purpose: Rule declarations use variable/constant terms; head variables must occur in the body.

schemas.name: base-facts
schemas.purpose: Finite ground facts and separately attested protected roots; root legitimacy needs a trusted adapter check.

schemas.name: derivation-certificate
schemas.purpose: Finite acyclic proof DAG with exact rule versions, ground substitutions and earlier premises.

schemas.name: closure-certificate
schemas.purpose: Claimed least fixed point; all initial facts, every rule consequence and no unexplained facts must be checked.

schemas.name: model-witness
schemas.purpose: Finite inhabited interpretation or countermodel, checked against every theory axiom and the claimed target.

schemas.name: proof-policy
schemas.purpose: Pin toolchain, isolate untrusted submissions and audit exact statements, dependencies and transitive axioms.

schemas.name: proof-submission
schemas.purpose: Untrusted proof submission; matching metadata does not itself prove its required statement.

schemas.name: proof-audit
schemas.purpose: Verifier-produced exact-statement, dependency, replay and axiom audit, bound to a proof submission.

schemas.name: provider-result
schemas.purpose: Raw provider execution separated from normalized verdict; exhausted bounded search is not theorem evidence.

schemas.name: obligation-result
schemas.purpose: Scoped verifier conclusion with independent execution, freshness and evidence-method dimensions.

schemas.name: compatibility-report
schemas.purpose: Selected-data compatibility, invariant preservation and model conservativity are independent claims.

schemas.name: invalidation-report
schemas.purpose: Changed dependency identities invalidate exactly scoped evidence; currentness is assessed by the verifier.

schemas.name: evidence-bundle
schemas.purpose: Replayable untrusted submission with exact scope and dependencies; does not carry client readiness flags.

schemas.name: review-report
schemas.purpose: Verifier-produced aggregate over independently derived hard obligations, not a client-owned all-passed flag.

schemas.name: check-receipt
schemas.purpose: Scoped checker outcome bound to exact inputs, invariant statement and explicit trust assumptions.

schemas.name: application-recheck
schemas.purpose: Candidate-only baseline recapture at simulated application; readiness is not governance authority.

schemas.name: job
schemas.purpose: Asynchronous execution lifecycle; accepted HTTP request is not semantic acceptance.

schemas.name: api-problem
schemas.purpose: Transport or service failure with an actionable code; semantic violations are result documents.

schemas.name: capabilities
schemas.purpose: Explicit supported profiles and actually available execution engines; this package starts no engine.

schemas.name: registry-assertion
schemas.purpose: Generated companion structural carrier for the captured registry. Enforces 41 kind versions, exact pairs and original closed qualifiers.

schemas.name: l0-assertion
schemas.purpose: Three-kind companion structural input. It covers the selected materialization kind without changing frozen Typed Relation/v2.

schemas.name: l0-graph
schemas.purpose: The companion finite graph with all assertions restricted to the selected three-kind structural carrier.

schemas.name: cancel-request
schemas.purpose: Cancellation requests terminate execution without producing readiness.

schemas.name: snapshot-request
schemas.purpose: Request contract for captureSnapshot; exact references must resolve through the local artifact store.

schemas.name: normalization-request
schemas.purpose: Request contract for normalizeGraph; exact references must resolve through the local artifact store.

schemas.name: check-request
schemas.purpose: Request contract for checkAddition; exact references must resolve through the local artifact store.

schemas.name: obligation-request
schemas.purpose: Request contract for deriveObligations; exact references must resolve through the local artifact store.

schemas.name: derivation-request
schemas.purpose: Request contract for checkDerivation; exact references must resolve through the local artifact store.

schemas.name: closure-request
schemas.purpose: Request contract for checkClosure; exact references must resolve through the local artifact store.

schemas.name: model-request
schemas.purpose: Request contract for checkModel; exact references must resolve through the local artifact store.

schemas.name: proof-request
schemas.purpose: Request contract for verifyProof; exact references must resolve through the local artifact store.

schemas.name: review-request
schemas.purpose: Request contract for reviewBundle; exact references must resolve through the local artifact store.

schemas.name: replay-request
schemas.purpose: Request contract for replayBundle; exact references must resolve through the local artifact store.

schemas.name: application-request
schemas.purpose: Request contract for recheckApplication; exact references must resolve through the local artifact store.

schemas.name: contract-set
schemas.purpose: Machine-readable preconditions, postconditions, failure rules and DAG traceability.

preconditions: Caller is authenticated and authorized to read every referenced artifact.
Resolve exact SHA-256 and byte size; do not fetch arbitrary URLs or evaluate submitted paths.
rules: Hash every source and resolve effective state through exact registry evidence.
postconditions: A selected immutable snapshot with explicit capture evidence; no perpetual currentness claim.
failure_controls: Missing overlays, source drift or ambiguous baseline.
trust_boundary: JSON shape validation is not semantic proof.
Submitted metadata and outputs remain untrusted until independently verified.

preconditions: Caller is authenticated and authorized to read every referenced artifact.
Resolve exact SHA-256 and byte size; do not fetch arbitrary URLs or evaluate submitted paths.
rules: Reject unknown kinds, identity collisions and malformed input; retain exact ordered pairs and original qualifier shapes.
postconditions: A deterministic projection with preservation mappings and explicit parser trust.
failure_controls: Pair widening, reordered identity bindings, omitted fields or unknown-kind escape.
trust_boundary: JSON shape validation is not semantic proof.
Submitted metadata and outputs remain untrusted until independently verified.

preconditions: Caller is authenticated and authorized to read every referenced artifact.
Resolve exact SHA-256 and byte size; do not fetch arbitrary URLs or evaluate submitted paths.
rules: Fully recheck the resulting graph against independently defined validity; structural scope stays separate.
postconditions: A scoped result; semantic-valid requires checked general soundness for the selected profile.
failure_controls: Invalid pair/qualifier/reference/invariant or unsupported semantic definition.
trust_boundary: JSON shape validation is not semantic proof.
Submitted metadata and outputs remain untrusted until independently verified.

preconditions: Caller is authenticated and authorized to read every referenced artifact.
Resolve exact SHA-256 and byte size; do not fetch arbitrary URLs or evaluate submitted paths.
rules: Compute the exact semantic diff and derive every required hard obligation using server-selected policy.
postconditions: Complete obligation set with coverage statement, including L3 obligations for rule changes.
failure_controls: Author relabeling, omitted hard obligations or unsupported change profiles.
trust_boundary: JSON shape validation is not semantic proof.
Submitted metadata and outputs remain untrusted until independently verified.

preconditions: Caller is authenticated and authorized to read every referenced artifact.
Resolve exact SHA-256 and byte size; do not fetch arbitrary URLs or evaluate submitted paths.
rules: Resolve every base leaf, exact rule and substitution; validate each premise and typed conclusion in a finite DAG.
postconditions: Sound supported conclusion only with generic derivation soundness evidence.
failure_controls: Cycle, missing premise, forged root, new identity or unbound external fact.
trust_boundary: JSON shape validation is not semantic proof.
Submitted metadata and outputs remain untrusted until independently verified.

preconditions: Caller is authenticated and authorized to read every referenced artifact.
Resolve exact SHA-256 and byte size; do not fetch arbitrary URLs or evaluate submitted paths.
rules: Check initial facts, closure under all ground rule instances and justified membership.
postconditions: Negative non-derivability only with least-fixed-point adequacy or an independent general theorem.
failure_controls: Incomplete saturation, invented member, wrong universe or timeout.
trust_boundary: JSON shape validation is not semantic proof.
Submitted metadata and outputs remain untrusted until independently verified.

preconditions: Caller is authenticated and authorized to read every referenced artifact.
Resolve exact SHA-256 and byte size; do not fetch arbitrary URLs or evaluate submitted paths.
rules: Verify a nonempty interpretation against every bound axiom; countermodel also negates the target statement.
postconditions: Checked witness with exact finite scope; a fully checked countermodel may refute a universal implication.
failure_controls: Empty domain, wrong arity, missing axiom, wrong target or exhausted search.
trust_boundary: JSON shape validation is not semantic proof.
Submitted metadata and outputs remain untrusted until independently verified.

preconditions: Caller is authenticated and authorized to read every referenced artifact.
Resolve exact SHA-256 and byte size; do not fetch arbitrary URLs or evaluate submitted paths.
rules: Isolate replay, pin the exact required statement and dependency closure, and audit transitive axioms.
postconditions: Audit of the actual theorem statement and policy; assumption and kernel boundaries remain explicit.
failure_controls: Weakened theorem, circular assumption, sorry, forbidden axiom or changed dependency.
trust_boundary: JSON shape validation is not semantic proof.
Submitted metadata and outputs remain untrusted until independently verified.

preconditions: Caller is authenticated and authorized to read every referenced artifact.
Resolve exact SHA-256 and byte size; do not fetch arbitrary URLs or evaluate submitted paths.
rules: Recompute all digests and required obligations independently; draft normative profiles cannot become semantically ready.
postconditions: Readiness only after every hard obligation has allowed, current, completed evidence; human meaning review remains explicit.
failure_controls: Missing hard result, stale dependencies, bounded-search upgrade or incomplete rule evidence.
trust_boundary: JSON shape validation is not semantic proof.
Submitted metadata and outputs remain untrusted until independently verified.

preconditions: Caller is authenticated and authorized to read every referenced artifact.
Resolve exact SHA-256 and byte size; do not fetch arbitrary URLs or evaluate submitted paths.
rules: Compare the complete bound dependency closure with the observed snapshot and rerun affected obligations.
postconditions: Currentness and invalidation are verifier-produced, not trusted client flags.
failure_controls: Changed registry, graph, profile, rule, evidence or proof dependency.
trust_boundary: JSON shape validation is not semantic proof.
Submitted metadata and outputs remain untrusted until independently verified.

preconditions: Caller is authenticated and authorized to read every referenced artifact.
Resolve exact SHA-256 and byte size; do not fetch arbitrary URLs or evaluate submitted paths.
rules: Recapture a trusted observed baseline and recheck at simulated application time.
postconditions: Candidate recommendation requiring separate human authority; authority effect remains none.
failure_controls: Review/application drift, reused stale receipt or request for actual admission.
trust_boundary: JSON shape validation is not semantic proof.
Submitted metadata and outputs remain untrusted until independently verified.

preconditions: Use the selected versioned profile and exact source identities.
rules: For named JSON envelopes reject invalid UTF-8, duplicate keys, schema mismatch and unsupported documents. Store raw proof, statement, provider and dependency bytes as untrusted artifacts. Resolve each operation's expected role/schema independently of upload labels; hash original bytes without reserialization.
postconditions: Artifact identifiers never grant read permission; access remains principal-scoped.
failure_controls: Client-supplied digest, size or currentness is never trusted.
trust_boundary: Implementing this declared rule still requires the corresponding DAG evidence.

preconditions: Use the selected versioned profile and exact source identities.
rules: Queued -> running -> completed/timeout/unavailable/failed; queued/running may cancel. Terminal states are immutable.
postconditions: HTTP 202 and completed job state say execution happened, not that an obligation was satisfied.
failure_controls: Completion is refused if its operation-specific result type or scope is wrong.
trust_boundary: Implementing this declared rule still requires the corresponding DAG evidence.

preconditions: Use the selected versioned profile and exact source identities.
rules: F0 starts with P01 relational semantics, P03 independent formal predicates, P04 Lean reference checker and P05 general soundness review. B00 baseline refresh and P02 schema/API/decoder alignment follow that accepted evidence. Every later task requires current predecessor evidence; G2 closes supported non-rule scope while I06 closes rule obligations.
postconditions: Contract authoring does not complete any implementation/proof gate in the DAG.
failure_controls: Plan/fixture receipts cannot substitute for execution acceptance.
trust_boundary: Implementing this declared rule still requires the corresponding DAG evidence.

preconditions: Use the selected versioned profile and exact source identities.
rules: Match targetVersion, effect, scope and epoch against legitimate roots across all indirect rule paths.
postconditions: Conformance may coexist with independently justified admission; conformance cannot justify admission.
failure_controls: Qualifier strings, axis names and untrusted adapter attestations cannot create authority roots.
trust_boundary: Implementing this declared rule still requires the corresponding DAG evidence.

preconditions: Use the selected versioned profile and exact source identities.
rules: Check selected data, generic invariant preservation and model conservativity separately.
postconditions: A conservative-extension claim covers every base model via an expansion with unchanged old reduct.
failure_controls: Pair widening is not unchanged old semantics; finite search exhaustion is not proof.
trust_boundary: Implementing this declared rule still requires the corresponding DAG evidence.

definition.description: Hash every source and resolve effective state through exact registry evidence. A selected immutable snapshot with explicit capture evidence; no perpetual currentness claim.

parameters.name: X-Artifact-Schema
parameters.description: Named interface envelope schema, or raw-artifact for untrusted proof source, required statement, provider output or pinned dependency bytes.

parameters.name: X-Artifact-Media-Type
parameters.description: The original artifact media type. Named envelope schemas require application/json; raw bytes cannot bypass operation-specific role and schema checks.

requestBody.description: Exact original bytes. Named envelope schemas require UTF-8 JSON with duplicate-key rejection. Raw proof, statement, provider-output and dependency bytes remain untrusted until their operation-specific verifier accepts them.

404.description: Bound artifact or job not found
